summary_for_children: Ash-Shura means Consultation. It praises believers who decide their affairs by consulting each other, and shows signs like ships on the sea that move only by the wind Allah sends.
environment_concept: A harbour where great ships rest when the wind stops and sail when it blows, with a council house where matters are decided by consultation.
architecture_and_scenery: Large harbour, a calm sea that can turn still, a simple council house with a circle of seats.

areas.name: Stilled Wind
areas.description: When the wind stops, the ships rest motionless.

areas.name: Council Circle
areas.description: A circle of seats for deciding together.

activities.name: Decide together
activities.description: Make group choices by asking each character's opinion (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Wind and sail
activities.description: Raise and lower the wind and watch the ships.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration ties consultation and patience to daily life.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
